changelog:
Talken 3.2

New:
- Public channels. Follow one with PC@handle from the + button, or create your own. Anyone can read a channel; only the people you authorise can post. Channels sit in your chat list alongside everything else.
- Channel details live in the same profile window a contact's do - photo, description, follower and post counts, and for owners: edit, manage who can post, and set a channel photo.
- Group profiles finally have controls: rename, add members, promote or remove someone, leave, and delete. Members are a proper list instead of a wall of text.
- The + button now fans out into New chat, New group and New channel.
- An Exit button in the sidebar that saves everything and closes properly - separate from the X, which hides to the tray.

Fixed:
- Closing the app saved nothing unless a Google Drive account was connected. Everything is now saved on exit and on logout, every time.
- Media messages sent without a caption were silently dropped on arrival.
- Opening a profile could crash the window for a contact with no cached profile.
- The profile window now scrolls as one page instead of trapping content in a panel.

Notes:
A channel's posts are read straight from storage, with no account and no server in the way. Talken never learns who follows what.
